title: Trump Wades Into Debate Over Irish Unification
description:
President Donald Trump stirred debate during his visit to Dublin by saying he would like to see a united Ireland and that unification is eventually inevitable, departing from the caution US presidents have traditionally shown on the issue. Bloomberg News White House Reporter Jennifer Dlouhy tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the remarks drew support from Sinn Féin and criticism from unionists, while UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said there is currently no mandate for a referendum.
